name: infiniFi USD
oneLiner: IUSD is infiniFi's USDC-collateralized dollar stablecoin, with reserves deployed duration-matched across institutional private credit and liquid DeFi lending.
collateral: USDC; deployed across institutional private credit strategies (Fasanara, Sentora, FalconX, Maple) and liquid DeFi markets (Spark, Fluid, Aave), duration-matched to user lock-up periods
pegMechanism: 1:1 mint/redeem against USDC with no fees; on-chain fractional reserve — liquid portion available for instant withdrawals, illiquid portion deployed to time-locked institutional lending strategies; redemptions queue when liquid reserves are insufficient

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: infiniFi publishes an Ethereum iUSD ReceiptToken, a direct LayerZero OFT on BNB Chain, and a Tempo TIP-20 iUSD with an OFT Adapter. The Tempo adapter's lock/unlock side is the weakest documented durable cross-chain route, so the profile uses external-lock-mint. The issuer-listed Plasma address is excluded because pinned on-chain metadata identifies it as iUSDT rather than iUSD.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: On 2026-07-30 the deployment inventory was re-derived. The Ethereum ReceiptToken 0x48f9e38f3070ad8945dfeae3fa70987722e3d89c read paused() = false at block 25648350 and its verified source exposes no holder blacklist or transfer hook; the BNB OFT 0x60B14ec49874Af1BA471685cb11132101aeBdF09 exposes no pause or blacklist selector. The decisive surface is the Tempo TIP-20 IUSD 0x20c000000000000000000000AB02D39df30bd17E: the TIP20Factory TokenCreated event at Tempo block 12424756 names creation admin 0xa11ce67cd9ad7295948a681617aa81e0523e0679; RoleMembershipUpdated logs show DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE granted to the infiniFi admin Safe 0x80608f852d152024c0a2087b16939235fec2400c at block 22529597 and the creation admin's own DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE revoked at block 22529608, with no subsequent role events through Tempo block 32484367, while ISSUER_ROLE is held by the reviewed LayerZero OFT adapter 0xfA339b5a3AD03fd9Ff048F574636b60d0FC7538A. getThreshold() = 4 confirms the 4-of-7 Safe is live on Tempo. Under the TIP-20 specification, DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE can immediately set the built-in always-reject policy or any TIP-403 blocklist policy via changeTransferPolicyId and can grant PAUSE_ROLE; the current paused() = false and transferPolicyId() = 1 (always-allow) are settings, not bounds on reach. The infiniFi Safe can therefore policy-block or pause IUSD transfers on Tempo today, so the asset-level direct holder-intervention posture is reviewed true (individual reach), superseding the 2026-07-22 possible.

mintAuthority.summary: IUSD receipt-token minting is gated by RECEIPT_TOKEN_MINTER in the infiniFi Core. Four protocol contracts hold the role; only YieldSharing is upgradeable. Mint-role administration, ReceiptToken core replacement, and YieldSharing upgrades all require the 4-of-7 admin Safe to schedule an action through a seven-day timelock.

controls.label: infiniFi admin Safe (PROPOSER_ROLE + MINOR_ROLES_MANAGER)

routeChecks.signingModel: The 4-of-7 Safe is the Timelock's sole proposer; no enabled Safe modules or transaction guard were detected.
routeChecks.rateLimits: RECEIPT_TOKEN_MINTER administration, ReceiptToken.setCore calls, and YieldSharing proxy upgrades initiated by this Safe must traverse Timelock 0x3d18480cc32b6ab3b833dcabd80e76cfd41c48a9 with getMinDelay() = 604800 seconds.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: The Safe is not a Core GOVERNOR and does not own ProxyAdmin directly. The Timelock holds GOVERNOR and owns ProxyAdmin 0x094227ee5e9c3877860ac212f1e5218441e5b4eb.

controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25527135, RECEIPT_TOKEN_MINTER's admin was GOVERNOR. Safe 0x80608f852d152024c0a2087b16939235fec2400c had MINOR_ROLES_MANAGER but not GOVERNOR; direct Safe grantRole/revokeRole calls reverted requiring GOVERNOR, and ReceiptToken.setCore reverted UNAUTHORIZED. Timelock 0x3d18480cc32b6ab3b833dcabd80e76cfd41c48a9 held GOVERNOR, had getMinDelay() = 604800, and the Safe was its sole proposer. YieldSharing ProxyAdmin 0x094227ee5e9c3877860ac212f1e5218441e5b4eb was owned by that Timelock; a direct Safe upgrade call reverted as unauthorized.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25527135, ReceiptToken 0x48f9e38f3070ad8945dfeae3fa70987722e3d89c, Core 0xf6d48735eccf12bdc1df2674b1ce3fcb3bd25490, MintController 0x49877d937b9a00d50557bdc3d87287b5c3a4c256, PLSmoother 0xc324569141697045b9ede54b5d4623a691ed57a4, and MigrationController 0x5f5403656e4db95accf1064a714b1bce351839f8 were direct non-proxy deployments. YieldSharing 0x90e91f5bfd9a0a4d925bf30b512add8cd2bbae3b was a transparent proxy with implementation 0x0d5dbf208a9a7540018d204a9a0ad08a091407e5 and ProxyAdmin 0x094227ee5e9c3877860ac212f1e5218441e5b4eb. The 4-of-7 Safe had no immediate GOVERNOR or ProxyAdmin-owner path: mint-role administration, ReceiptToken core replacement, and YieldSharing upgrades all converged on Timelock 0x3d18480cc32b6ab3b833dcabd80e76cfd41c48a9 with a 604800-second minimum delay. IUSD is receipt-token issuance through the fixed protocol minters, and every path to replace the receipt core, add a minter, or change the upgradeable mint module traverses that seven-day delay; economic cap semantics are therefore raiseable rather than unbounded.

reserves.name: Liquid Cap stcUSD
reserves.issuerOrObligor: Cap Credit Engine and institutional operators

reserveReview.rationale: The infiniFi protocol API was re-read on 2026-07-27. Its active-farm allocation explicitly identifies every material position, including Liquid Cap stcUSD at 5.1% and FalconX Institutional at 3.3%; the production adapter reports no unknown farm and only a negligible source-total reconciliation gap.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: infiniFi protocol data API active-farm allocation
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No unresolved material composition group remains: the only non-farm protocol position is RedeemController, whose source-total reconciliation gap is below the adapter's 0.5% threshold.
